newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-FERGUSON AND HENDRY RECALLED BY SCOTLAND.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FERGUSON AND HENDRY RECALLED BY SCOTLAND.

text.p: Everton striker Duncan Ferguson and Blackburn defender Colin Hendry, both sidelined for a month, were recalled on Thursday for Scotland's World Cup qualifier against Sweden on November 10.
Manager Craig Brown is banking on the pair having recovered from operations in time for the crucial European group four match in Glasgow.
Brown sees Ferguson as a key figure in his bid to win a place in the 1998 finals.
"Having Duncan available is a boost as it comes when we could be without other important players," said Brown. "The word is that he is fit and flying and desperate to play again."
Rangers trio Alan McLaren, Stuart McCall and Gordon Durie are all unfit.

Squad: Tommy Boyd, Craig Burley, Colin Calderwood, John Collins, Billy Dodds, Duncan Ferguson, Kevin Gallacher, Scott Gemmill, Andy Goram, Colin Hendry, Darren Jackson, Eoin Jess, Paul Lambert, Jim Leighton, Gary McAllister, Ally McCoist, John McGinlay, Tosh McKinlay, Billy McKinlay, Jackie McNamara, John Spencer, Nicky Walker, Derek Whyte.
